# MeritMoon: A Kinder Mind Changes Everything

> **Slogan:** A Kinder Mind Changes Everything  
> **Mission:** The discipline-first meditation platform rooted in ancient wisdom.  
> **Official Hub:** https://meritmoon.com  
> **Practices:** Ānāpāna (Breath), Jhāna (Absorptions), Vipassanā (Insight), Mettā (Loving-Kindness)  
> **Core Model:** 100% free with your commitment (Discipline or Devotion)  
> **Platforms:** Web (React 19), Mobile (iOS & Android via Flutter 3), API Backend (Ruby on Rails 8)  

---

## 🌿 Core Overview

MeritMoon is a discipline-first meditation sanctuary designed to cultivate genuine mental stillness, clarity, and compassion. Unlike conventional wellness apps focused on gamified streaks or superficial relaxation sounds, MeritMoon returns to authentic contemplation traditions dating back thousands of years.

### Key Pillars:
1. **Ancient Meditation Techniques:**
   - **Ānāpāna:** Mindful observation of the natural breath to develop initial focus and single-pointed stillness.
   - **Jhāna Absorptions:** Deep meditative joy (*Pīti*) and tranquil concentration (*Sukha*).
   - **Vipassanā:** Direct insight into impermanence (*Anicca*), non-self (*Anattā*), and the nature of suffering.
   - **Mettā:** Cultivating boundless benevolence and loving-kindness toward all living beings.

2. **The Path of Merits (Dāna):**
   - MeritMoon operates on the principle that transformative meditation should never be paywalled.
   - Core practice is 100% free with your daily commitment.
   - Users pay with either **discipline** (maintaining daily practice) or **devotion** (supporting real meditation teachers and monasteries through direct voluntary contributions).

3. **Forest Moonlit Night Aesthetic:**
   - Designed around deep ancient forest nightscapes, serene moonlight, silver-on-emerald tones, and warm golden moonbeams.
   - Features the iconic interactive 3D Mindful Moon Mascot.

---

## 🏛️ Tri-Platform Architecture

- **Web Client (`meritmoon-web`):** Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, DaisyUI, and Three.js.
- **Mobile Client (`meritmoon-mobile`):** Cross-platform Flutter 3 application with offline-first local audio/timer persistence.
- **Backend Core (`meritmoon-core`):** High-performance Ruby on Rails 8 API with PostgreSQL, Solid Queue, and Garage S3 storage.
